close_reason: SystemTime subtraction can't fail in practice; fallback to timestamp 0 is safe and tested.
description: email.rs next_id() (line ~1647): BASE.get_or_init calls SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_nanos() as u64).unwrap_or(1_000_000_000). The .unwrap_or silently falls back to a fixed nanosecond base, producing highly collision-prone IDs if the system clock is before the epoch (which can happen in containerized CI). The fallback constant should be documented with a comment explaining why 1_000_000_000 is chosen, or the code should propagate a detectable error rather than silently using a collision-prone base. This is library code that callers depend on for thread ID uniqueness.
title: next_id() uses unwrap_or on SystemTime::duration_since
